properties.areaDesc: Wilbarger, TX
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 16 at 3:00AM CDT until October 17 at 4:28AM CDT by NWS Norman OK
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Pease River near Vernon affecting Wilbarger County.

For the Pease River...including Vernon...Moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Pease River near Vernon.

* WHEN...Until late tonight.

* IMPACTS...At 17.0 feet, Overflow depths up to about 2 feet affects
agricultural lands and low-lying roads along the Pease River in
northern Wilbarger County.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 2:00 AM CDT Friday the stage was 14.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 15.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early
this morning to a crest of 17.0 feet this afternoon. It will then
fall below flood stage late this evening.
- Flood stage is 15.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 17.0
feet on 05/15/1980.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this afternoon at 300 PM CDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL LATE TONIGHT

properties.areaDesc: Jackson, OK; Kiowa, OK; Tillman, OK
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 16 at 2:58AM CDT until October 18 at 6:24AM CDT by NWS Norman OK
properties.description:
...Forecast flooding changed from Minor to Moderate severity and
increased in duration for the following rivers in Oklahoma...

North Fork Red River near Headrick affecting Jackson, Kiowa and
Tillman Counties.

For the North Fork Red River...including Carter, Headrick...Moderate
flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...North Fork Red River near Headrick.

* WHEN...Until Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 16.0 feet, Flooding or isolation of agricultural lands
and rural roads occurs in Kiowa... Jackson... and Tillman counties.
Upstream points in Kiowa County may see flooding several hours
before the crest reaches the Headrick area. The flood crest reaches
downstream points near Tipton much later. Flood depths approach 2
feet over some areas along the river.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 2:00 AM CDT Friday the stage was 15.9 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 13.5 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 2:00 AM CDT Friday was 15.9 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 16.4 feet
this afternoon. It will then fall below flood stage early Sunday
morning.
- Flood stage is 14.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 16.5
feet on 10/05/1955.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this afternoon at 300 PM CDT.

Pillsbury, 419 including the City of Clearlake, Middletown,
Lower Lake, and Indian Valley Reservoir, and 420 including
Cobb and Mount Konocti.

* WIND...Sustained winds of 15 to 25 mph with gusts to 35 mph
possible in exposed areas.

Friday.

are either occurring now, or will shortly. A combination of
strong winds, low relative humidity, and warm temperatures can
contribute to extreme fire behavior.

properties.areaDesc: Brewster, TX
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 16 at 2:47AM CDT until October 18 at 6:44AM CDT by NWS Midland/Odessa TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Rio Grande at Rio Grande at Rio Grande Village, BBNP, Texas
affecting Brewster County.

For the Rio Grande...including Rio Grande above Rio Conchos near
Presidio,  Texas, Test Forecast Point A, Rio Grande at Presidio
Vehicle Bridge, Rio Grande below Rio Conchos near Presidio,  Texas,
Rio Grande near Castolon,  Texas, Rio Grande at Johnson Ranch near
Castolon,  Texas, Rio Grande at Rio Grande Village,  BBNP,  Texas,
Rio Grande near Dryden,  Texas, Terlingua Creek near Terlingua,
Texas...Moderate flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Rio Grande at Rio Grande at Rio Grande Village, BBNP,
Texas.

* WHEN...Until Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, the river reaches bankfull, and no damage
is expected.  Preparations may be necessary to remove water pumps.
The park should be notified at this time if additional rises are
expected so they will have time to remove the pumps. At 13.0 feet,
the river reaches minor flood stage.  Water reaches the water pumps
maintained by the park service that are used to water the
campgrounds and to provide water to the employee living quarters.
It may be necessary for park personnel to remove the pumps. At 15.0
feet, the river reaches moderate flood stage.  Water pumps
submerge.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 2:00 AM CDT Friday the stage was 1.4 feet (0.4 meters).
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet (3.7 meters).
- Forecast...The river will rise above flood stage early this
morning to 16.7 feet (5.1 meters) late this morning. It will then
fall below flood stage this evening to 5.7 feet (1.7 meters) late
tomorrow morning. It will rise to 6.3 feet (1.9 meters) tomorrow
afternoon. It will then fall again and remain below flood stage.
- Flood stage is 13.0 feet (4.0 meters).
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 16.5
feet (5.0 meters) on 05/28/2023.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this afternoon at 300 PM CDT.
